tours.name: Finance: Find Vendor Outstanding Balance (Engineer - Production)

name_i18n.en_US: Finance: Find Vendor Outstanding Balance (Engineer - Production)
name_i18n.si_LK: Finance: Find Vendor Outstanding Balance (Engineer - Production)

tours.description: Locate a vendor's outstanding balance in four ways: the Due smart button on the vendor master record, the Partner Ledger, the Aged Payable report, and the vendor bill list. Worked example uses the vendor Engineer - Production.

description_i18n.en_US: Locate a vendor's outstanding balance in four ways: the Due smart button on the vendor master record, the Partner Ledger, the Aged Payable report, and the vendor bill list. Worked example uses the vendor Engineer - Production.

description_i18n.ta_IN: Locate a vendor's outstanding balance in four ways: the Due smart button on the vendor master record, the Partner Ledger, the Aged Payable report, and the vendor bill list. Worked example uses the vendor Engineer - Production.

steps.title: Open Accounting app
steps.content: Click the Accounting app. Every vendor outstanding balance is found from here.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Accounting app. Every vendor outstanding balance is found from here.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Accounting app. Every vendor outstanding balance is found from here.

steps.title: Open the Vendors menu
steps.content: Open the Vendors menu. This holds the vendor master, bills and payments.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the Vendors menu. This holds the vendor master, bills and payments.

steps.title: Open Vendors master list
steps.content: Click Vendors. This is the vendor master where every supplier record is kept.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Vendors. This is the vendor master where every supplier record is kept.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Vendors. This is the vendor master where every supplier record is kept.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Vendors. This is the vendor master where every supplier record is kept.

steps.title: Search the vendor
steps.content: Type Engineer - Production in the search box and press Enter to filter the vendor master down to this vendor.

content_i18n.en_US: Type Engineer - Production in the search box and press Enter to filter the vendor master down to this vendor.
content_i18n.si_LK: Type Engineer - Production in the search box and press Enter to filter the vendor master down to this vendor.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Type Engineer - Production in the search box and press Enter to filter the vendor master down to this vendor.

steps.title: Open the vendor record
steps.content: Click the Engineer - Production card to open the vendor master record.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the Engineer - Production card to open the vendor master record.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click the Engineer - Production card to open the vendor master record.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click the Engineer - Production card to open the vendor master record.

steps.title: Open the More smart buttons
steps.content: Click More. The accounting smart buttons - Due, Invoiced and Partner Ledger - are grouped here.

content_i18n.en_US: Click More. The accounting smart buttons - Due, Invoiced and Partner Ledger - are grouped here.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click More. The accounting smart buttons - Due, Invoiced and Partner Ledger - are grouped here.

steps.title: Read the Due amount
steps.content: The Due smart button shows the vendor's outstanding balance straight from the master record. Read the figure here, then click it to open the follow-up detail.

content_i18n.en_US: The Due smart button shows the vendor's outstanding balance straight from the master record. Read the figure here, then click it to open the follow-up detail.

steps.title: Back to the vendor record
steps.content: The follow-up screen lists the open items and Total Due. Click the breadcrumb to go back to the vendor record.

steps.title: Open More again
steps.content: Open the More smart buttons again to reach the Partner Ledger.

content_i18n.en_US: Open the More smart buttons again to reach the Partner Ledger.

steps.title: Open the Partner Ledger
steps.content: Click Partner Ledger to see every posted entry for this vendor and the running outstanding balance.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Partner Ledger to see every posted entry for this vendor and the running outstanding balance.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Partner Ledger to see every posted entry for this vendor and the running outstanding balance.

steps.title: Read the Partner Ledger total
steps.content: The list is filtered to Partner = Engineer - Production, Posted, Payable or Receivable. The Debit and Credit totals on this row are the vendor's outstanding balance; the difference between them is what is still open.

content_i18n.en_US: The list is filtered to Partner = Engineer - Production, Posted, Payable or Receivable. The Debit and Credit totals on this row are the vendor's outstanding balance; the difference between them is what is still open.

steps.title: Open the Reporting menu
steps.content: Click Reporting to reach the Aged Payable report, the standard way to see what is outstanding to a vendor by age.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Reporting to reach the Aged Payable report, the standard way to see what is outstanding to a vendor by age.
content_i18n.si_LK: Click Reporting to reach the Aged Payable report, the standard way to see what is outstanding to a vendor by age.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Click Reporting to reach the Aged Payable report, the standard way to see what is outstanding to a vendor by age.

steps.title: Open Aged Payable
steps.content: Under Partner Reports click Aged Payable. It lists every vendor with the amount outstanding split into ageing buckets.

content_i18n.en_US: Under Partner Reports click Aged Payable. It lists every vendor with the amount outstanding split into ageing buckets.
content_i18n.si_LK: Under Partner Reports click Aged Payable. It lists every vendor with the amount outstanding split into ageing buckets.
content_i18n.ta_IN: Under Partner Reports click Aged Payable. It lists every vendor with the amount outstanding split into ageing buckets.

steps.title: Read the vendor row
steps.content: Find the Engineer - Production row and read across to the Total column - that figure is the outstanding payable as at the report date. A negative figure means we are in debit with the vendor (a payment or advance not yet matched to a bill). Click the row name to unfold the individual bills and payments behind it.

A negative figure means we are in debit with the vendor (a payment or advance not yet matched to a bill). Click the row name to unfold the individual bills and payments behind it.

steps.title: Back to the Vendors menu
steps.content: Open the Vendors menu again - this time to check the bills behind the balance.

steps.title: Open Vendor Bills
steps.content: Click Bills to open the vendor bill list, where the Amount Due column shows what is still unpaid per bill.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Bills to open the vendor bill list, where the Amount Due column shows what is still unpaid per bill.

steps.title: Filter bills by vendor
steps.content: Type Engineer - Production and press Enter to keep only this vendor's bills.

steps.content: The Payment and Status columns tell you which bills are still open; Total is the amount due on each. If no bills appear, the vendor has no open bills and the balance seen earlier comes from an unmatched payment or advance.
